consent_copy.auto_scrub_limit.context: Consent decision: preserve exact scope, destination and consequences before the action. Field: consent_copy.auto_scrub_limit.
consent_copy.auto_scrub_limit.english: The patterns are reliable for the formats they cover. Beyond those, in text they catch only a long, random-looking value right after a word like "password" or "token", and are blind to everything else. The model is not reliable. Nothing here checks whether either of them was right.

consent_copy.auto_scrub_scope.context: Consent decision: preserve exact scope, destination and consequences before the action. Field: consent_copy.auto_scrub_scope.
consent_copy.auto_scrub_scope.english: Fixed patterns remove API keys and tokens in the formats we know, and many file paths and email addresses that name you. A bearer token in any other format is removed when it is long, looks random and follows "Bearer" after a space or colon, unless it is shaped like a UUID or another known kind of ID; one that is short, or run straight onto "Bearer", can get through. Everything else -- names, people, addresses, account numbers, a password typed into a sentence -- is removed when a model recognises it.

consent_copy.gate_statement.english: "Exactly what would be sent" is the exact text that would leave this machine. Pattern-based scrubbing may have missed something in it, and nothing here checks that you looked.

message.contribution_override_confirm_js.english:
Traces from every folder will be scrubbed and contributed without asking you, from now on, until you turn this off. You won't review them first. Traces already on this Mac keep waiting for you to pick them, and folders set to Never stay off.

witness_copy.admission.failed_hosts_untr.english: This trace could not be prepared, because one of the addresses it must call is not on the allowed-hosts list for this computer. Whoever set this computer up needs to allow it. Nothing left the machine.

witness_copy.admission.failed_not_enroll.context: Witness and wallet settings: preserve verification limits and disclosure scope. Field: witness_copy.admission.failed_not_enrolled.
witness_copy.admission.failed_not_enroll.english: This trace could not be prepared, because this computer is not connected to a commons yet. Finish joining, then come back to this trace.

witness_copy.admission.failed_permission.context: Witness and wallet settings: preserve verification limits and disclosure scope. Field: witness_copy.admission.failed_permission.
witness_copy.admission.failed_permission.english: This trace could not be prepared, because sending captured inference bodies has not been permitted. Open Settings and give that permission, then confirm this trace again. Nothing is sent until you do.

witness_copy.admission.failed_proxy_miss.english: This trace could not be prepared, because the local proxy that records model calls is not running or is not capturing them. Start it and turn on body capture, then confirm this trace again.

witness_copy.admission.failed_proxy_untr.context: Witness and wallet settings: preserve verification limits and disclosure scope. Field: witness_copy.admission.failed_proxy_untrusted.
witness_copy.admission.failed_proxy_untr.english: This trace could not be prepared, because the local proxy's control file did not pass its safety check. Nothing was sent. Restart the proxy so it writes a fresh one, and if it keeps happening, ask for help before retrying.

witness_copy.admission.failed_receipt_en.context: Witness and wallet settings: preserve verification limits and disclosure scope. Field: witness_copy.admission.failed_receipt_endpoint.
witness_copy.admission.failed_receipt_en.english: This trace could not be prepared, and nothing in your settings will fix it. Your commons has not published a receipt service, so there is nowhere to collect the provider's signature for this inference. Ask the operator of your commons to publish one. You can still contribute existing history without it.

witness_copy.admission.failed_receipt_en.context: Witness and wallet settings: preserve verification limits and disclosure scope. Field: witness_copy.admission.failed_receipt_endpoint_invalid.
witness_copy.admission.failed_receipt_en.english: This trace could not be prepared. The receipt service configured for this computer is not an address this app will call, so the provider's signature cannot be collected. Whoever set it up needs to correct it. You can still contribute existing history without it.

witness_copy.admission.failed_session_un.context: Witness and wallet settings: preserve verification limits and disclosure scope. Field: witness_copy.admission.failed_session_unreadable.
witness_copy.admission.failed_session_un.english: This trace could not be prepared, because its file could not be read back. It may have been moved, deleted, or still be in use by the agent. Pick another trace, or close the agent and try again.

witness_copy.admission.failed_source_uns.english: This trace could not be prepared, because it was produced by an agent this app cannot read yet. Use a supported agent for the task you want to contribute. Traces from other agents are left alone.

witness_copy.admission.failed_try_again.context: Witness and wallet settings: preserve verification limits and disclosure scope. Field: witness_copy.admission.failed_try_again.
witness_copy.admission.failed_try_again.english: This trace could not be prepared this time. Your commons or the local proxy declined the attempt, which is usually temporary. Confirm the trace again in a moment.

witness_copy.review.disclosure.context: Witness and wallet settings: preserve verification limits and disclosure scope. Field: witness_copy.review.disclosure.
witness_copy.review.disclosure.english: This sends this trace, including its unredacted conversation and any correction you include, to your configured remote witness before you approve a contribution. It may contain prompts, tool results, personal data, or secrets. Captured inference bodies are included only with the separate saved permission. You can inspect the returned redacted contribution before deciding whether to send it. Cancelling afterwards cannot recall a trace already sent to the witness.

witness_copy.review.failed.context: Witness and wallet settings: preserve verification limits and disclosure scope. Field: witness_copy.review.failed.

witness_copy.review.failed_busy.context: Witness and wallet settings: preserve verification limits and disclosure scope. Field: witness_copy.review.failed_busy.
witness_copy.review.failed_busy.english: The review could not go ahead yet, because the privacy witness is busy checking other traces. Nothing was sent and nothing has been approved. It will be free again soon.

witness_copy.review.failed_host_not_allo.context: Witness and wallet settings: preserve verification limits and disclosure scope. Field: witness_copy.review.failed_host_not_allowed.
witness_copy.review.failed_host_not_allo.english: The review could not go ahead, because the reviewer's address is not on the allowed list for this computer. Nothing left the machine. Whoever set this computer up needs to allow it.

witness_copy.review.failed_measurement_u.context: Witness and wallet settings: preserve verification limits and disclosure scope. Field: witness_copy.review.failed_measurement_unpinned.
witness_copy.review.failed_measurement_u.english: The review could not go ahead, because this computer has nothing recorded to check the reviewer against, or what it reported did not match. Nothing was sent. Record the value your commons publishes for its reviewer, then try again.

witness_copy.review.failed_not_connected.context: Witness and wallet settings: preserve verification limits and disclosure scope. Field: witness_copy.review.failed_not_connected.
witness_copy.review.failed_not_connected.english: The review could not go ahead, because this computer is not connected to a commons yet. Finish joining, then come back to this trace.

witness_copy.review.failed_receipt_decli.context: Witness and wallet settings: preserve verification limits and disclosure scope. Field: witness_copy.review.failed_receipt_declined.
witness_copy.review.failed_receipt_decli.english: The review was refused, because the reviewer would not accept the signature covering this trace's model call -- which one answered, which model, or how small the request was. Nothing has been approved. This is a setting where your commons runs, not here, so ask its operator. You can still contribute existing history without it.

witness_copy.review.failed_too_large.context: Witness and wallet settings: preserve verification limits and disclosure scope. Field: witness_copy.review.failed_too_large.
witness_copy.review.failed_too_large.english: This trace is larger than the review will carry, so nothing was offered and nothing left the machine. It cannot be contributed this way.

witness_copy.review.failed_unproven.context: Witness and wallet settings: preserve verification limits and disclosure scope. Field: witness_copy.review.failed_unproven.
witness_copy.review.failed_unproven.english: The review was refused, because the reviewer could not show it is the one you recorded. Nothing was sent onward and nothing has been approved. This is deliberate -- a reviewer that cannot prove itself does not get used. Ask whoever runs your commons before trying again.

witness_copy.review.failed_unreachable.context: Witness and wallet settings: preserve verification limits and disclosure scope. Field: witness_copy.review.failed_unreachable.
witness_copy.review.failed_unreachable.english: The review could not go ahead, because the reviewer did not answer, or answered something this app could not read. Nothing has been approved and nothing has been lost. Try again in a little while.
